law_title: THE PARTY WHICH GOES FROM HOME
text: shall have the choice of the Innings, and the pitching of the Wickets, which shall be pitched within thirty yards of a center fixed by the Adversaries.
text_norm: shall have the choice of the innings, and the pitching of the wickets, which shall be pitched within thirty yards of a center fixed by the adversaries.

law_title: THE PARTY WHICH GOES FROM HOME
text: When the Parties meet at a third place, the Bowlers shall toss-up for the pitching of the Wickets, and the choice of going in.
text_norm: when the parties meet at a third place, the bowlers shall toss-up for the pitching of the wickets, and the choice of going in.

law_title: THE PARTY WHICH GOES FROM HOME
text: It shall not be lawful for either Party during a Match without the consent of the other to alter the Ground, by rolling, watering, covering, mowing, or beating; this rule is not meant to prevent a Striker from beating the ground with his Bat near where he stands during the Innings, or to prevent the Bowler from filling up holes, watering his ground, or using Sawdust, &c. when the ground is wet.
text_norm: it shall not be lawful for either party during a match without the consent of the other to alter the ground, by rolling, watering, covering, mowing, or beating; this rule is not meant to prevent a striker from beating the ground with his bat near where he stands during the innings, or to prevent the bowler from filling up holes, watering his ground, or using sawdust, &c. when the ground is wet.

text: shall deliver the Ball with one foot behind the Bowling Crease, and within the Return Crease and shall bowl four Balls before he changes Wickets, which he shall do but once in the same innings.
text_norm: shall deliver the ball with one foot behind the bowling crease, and within the return crease and shall bowl four balls before he changes wickets, which he shall do but once in the same innings.

text: He may order the Striker, at his Wicket, to stand on which side of it he pleases.
text_norm: he may order the striker, at his wicket, to stand on which side of it he pleases.

text: if the Bail is bowled off, or the Stump bowled out of the ground.
text_norm: if the bail is bowled off, or the stump bowled out of the ground.

text: Or, if the Ball, from a stroke over or under his Bat, or upon his hand, (but not wrists) is held before it touches the ground, although it be hugged to the body of the Catcher.
text_norm: or, if the ball, from a stroke over or under his bat, or upon his hand, (but not wrists) is held before it touches the ground, although it be hugged to the body of the catcher.

text: Or, if in striking, or at any other time while the Ball is in play, both his feet are over the Popping Crease and his Wicket put down, except his Bat is grounded within it.
text_norm: or, if in striking, or at any other time while the ball is in play, both his feet are over the popping crease and his wicket put down, except his bat is grounded within it.

text: Or, if under pretence of running a Notch, or otherwise, either of the Strikers prevent a Ball from being caught, the Striker of the Ball is out.
text_norm: or, if under pretence of running a notch, or otherwise, either of the strikers prevent a ball from being caught, the striker of the ball is out.

text: Or, if the Ball is struck up, and he wilfully strikes it again.
text_norm: or, if the ball is struck up, and he wilfully strikes it again.

text: Or, if running a Notch the Wicket is struck down by a throw, or with the Ball in hand, before his foot, hand, or bat, is grounded over the Popping Crease.
text_norm: or, if running a notch the wicket is struck down by a throw, or with the ball in hand, before his foot, hand, or bat, is grounded over the popping crease.

text: But if the Bail is off, the Stump must be struck out of the ground.
text_norm: but if the bail is off, the stump must be struck out of the ground.

text: Or, if the Striker touches or takes up the Ball while in play, unless at the request of the opposite Party.
text_norm: or, if the striker touches or takes up the ball while in play, unless at the request of the opposite party.

text: If with his foot or leg he stops the Ball, which the Bowler in the opinion of the Umpire at the Bowler’s Wicket shall have pitched in straight line to the Wicket, and would have hit it.
text_norm: if with his foot or leg he stops the ball, which the bowler in the opinion of the umpire at the bowler's wicket shall have pitched in straight line to the wicket, and would have hit it.

text: If the Players have crossed each other, he that runs for the Wicket which is put down, is out; if they are not crossed, he that has left the Wicket which is put down is out.
text_norm: if the players have crossed each other, he that runs for the wicket which is put down, is out; if they are not crossed, he that has left the wicket which is put down is out.

text: When a Ball is caught, no Notch to be reckoned.
text_norm: when a ball is caught, no notch to be reckoned.

text: When a Striker is run out, the Notch they were running for is not to be reckoned.
text_norm: when a striker is run out, the notch they were running for is not to be reckoned.

text: When the Ball has been in the Bowler’s or Wicketkeepers hands, it is considered as no longer in Play, and the Strikers need not keep within their ground till the Umpire has called Play; but if the Player goes out of his ground with an intent to run before the Ball is delivered, the Bowler may put him out.
text_norm: when the ball has been in the bowler's or wicketkeepers hands, it is considered as no longer in play, and the strikers need not keep within their ground till the umpire has called play; but if the player goes out of his ground with an intent to run before the ball is delivered, the bowler may put him out.

text: If the Ball is struck up, the Striker may guard his Wicket either with his Bat or his Body.
text_norm: if the ball is struck up, the striker may guard his wicket either with his bat or his body.

text: In single Wicket Matches, if the Striker moves out of his ground to strike at the Ball, he shall be allowed no Notch for such stroke.
text_norm: in single wicket matches, if the striker moves out of his ground to strike at the ball, he shall be allowed no notch for such stroke.

text: shall stand at a reasonable distance behind the Wicket, and shall not move till the Ball is out of the Bowler’s hand, and shall not by any noise incommode the Striker; and if his hands, knees, feet, or head, be over or before the Wicket, though the Ball hit it, it shall not be out.
text_norm: shall stand at a reasonable distance behind the wicket, and shall not move till the ball is out of the bowler's hand, and shall not by any noise incommode the striker; and if his hands, knees, feet, or head, be over or before the wicket, though the ball hit it, it shall not be out.

text: are the sole judges of fair and unfair play, and all disputes shall be determined by them; each at his own Wicket.
text_norm: are the sole judges of fair and unfair play, and all disputes shall be determined by them; each at his own wicket.

text: But in case of a Catch, which the Umpire at the Wicket cannot see sufficiently to decide upon, he may apply to the other Umpire whose opinion is conclusive.
text_norm: but in case of a catch, which the umpire at the wicket cannot see sufficiently to decide upon, he may apply to the other umpire whose opinion is conclusive.

text: They shall allow two minutes for each man to come in, and fifteen minutes between each Innings; when the Umpire shall call Play, the party refusing to play, shall lose the Match.
text_norm: they shall allow two minutes for each man to come in, and fifteen minutes between each innings; when the umpire shall call play, the party refusing to play, shall lose the match.

text: When a Striker is hurt, they are to permit another to come in, and the person hurt shall have his hands in any part of the Innings.
text_norm: when a striker is hurt, they are to permit another to come in, and the person hurt shall have his hands in any part of the innings.

text: They are not to order a Player out, unless appealed to by the Adversaries.
text_norm: they are not to order a player out, unless appealed to by the adversaries.

text: But, if the Bowler’s foot is not behind the Bowling Crease and within the Return Crease, when he delivers the Ball, they must, unasked, call No Ball.
text_norm: but, if the bowler's foot is not behind the bowling crease and within the return crease, when he delivers the ball, they must, unasked, call no ball.

text: If the Striker runs a short Notch, the Umpire must call No Notch.
text_norm: if the striker runs a short notch, the umpire must call no notch.

text: That the Umpire at the Bowler’s Wicket shall be first applied to decide on all Catches.
text_norm: that the umpire at the bowler's wicket shall be first applied to decide on all catches.

text: If the Notches of one Player are laid against another, the Bets depend on the first Innings, unless otherwise specified.
text_norm: if the notches of one player are laid against another, the bets depend on the first innings, unless otherwise specified.

text: If the Bets are made upon both Innings, and one party beat the other in one Innings, the Notches in the first Innings shall determine the Bet.
text_norm: if the bets are made upon both innings, and one party beat the other in one innings, the notches in the first innings shall determine the bet.

text: But if the other Party goes in a second time, then the Bets must be determined by the number on the Score.
text_norm: but if the other party goes in a second time, then the bets must be determined by the number on the score.
